name: Staff of Aspects
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 194
Aura moderate transmutation CL 9th
Slot none; Price 37,600 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This stout staff is made of ash. Four faces of animals—a bear, a falcon, a stag, and a wolf—are carved at its top. The aspect staff functions as a +1/+1 quarterstaff and allows the use of the following spells:
Aspect of the bear (1 charge; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Aspect of the falcon (1 charge; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Aspect of the stag (2 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Aspect of the wolf (3 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Staff, aspect of the bear, aspect of the falcon, aspect of the stag, aspect of the wolf; Cost 19,100 gp
